title: Change of site preserves the fixed-coefficient open scalar mate
statement: For finite commutative rings A and B, a homomorphism phi:A -> B, an open immersion j:X -> Z, and an unbounded etale A-complex G, the fixed pro-etale open scalar transpose at comparisonUpperStar_X(G), followed by extension by zero of pbcComparisonReduction_X, equals fixed scalar extension of the inverse open/site comparison at G, followed by pbcComparisonReduction_Z, etale-pro-etale comparison of openScalarIso, and the open/site comparison for B. No intrinsic coefficient realization occurs.

proof.text: The ordinary fixed open restriction comparison preserves the open adjunction unit. Conjugate this equation by the canonical open pullback/restriction isomorphisms, and use exact localization to preserve it. The unit formula for leftAdjointUniq identifies its scalar transpose with OpenScalarSite.scalarOpen.

The inverse of the etale open restriction scalar square equals upperStarRestrictScalarsIsoSheaf. Therefore the published open scalar isomorphism in EtaleOpenTensorDefs is definitionally the same adjoint uniqueness isomorphism as FiniteCompactScalar.openScalarIso.

Use the already proved private scalar_site_square_aux as the formal mate-cube assembly of its actual lower inputs: the coefficient/site restriction comparison normalized by the comparison-adjunction units, the open/site unit normalization and its exact derived descent, and the exact square composition law. These are the inputs of restriction_coefficient_cube, derived_coefficient_cube, scalar_pullback_cube and comparison_derived_extension_mate in its proof. Precompose the resulting unbounded square by fixed scalar extension of the inverse open/site comparison and cancel hom with inverse. The full public lem-sp-open-scalar-site-coherence aggregate (which also asserts flatness and composition laws) is not used as a theorem.

theorem fixedOpenScalar_site_transport
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (G : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) X) :
    (((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
      (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology Z)
        (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)))).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j).mapDerivedCategory.map
            (((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
      (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology X)
        (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)))).unit.app
              ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj G)) ≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso (sfFixedOpenRestriction j φ)).hom.app
            ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtension (ProEt.topology X)
              (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)).obj
              ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj G))) ≫
      (ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) j).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((ProEtale.pbcComparisonReduction X (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)).hom.app G) =
    (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtension (ProEt.topology Z) (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)).map
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
          (ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j)).inv.app G) ≫
      (ProEtale.pbcComparisonReduction Z (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)).hom.app
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj G) ≫
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) Z).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((Etale.FiniteCompactScalar.openScalarIso
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) j).hom.app G) ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
        (ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) j)).hom.app
        ((Etale.scalarExtension (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) X).obj G)
